stem_book: (One or more than one option may be correct) Which of the following statements is/are correct? [P–V plot: from a common starting point, A is a vertical line down, D a horizontal line, C a gentle curve and B a steeper curve] (a) A represents isochoric process (b) B represents adiabatic process (c) C represents isothermal process (d) D represents isobaric process
reason: Manifest stem said B is the steepest curve but A (vertical) is steeper; reworded. Figure required.
work: Vertical ⇒ isochoric; horizontal ⇒ isobaric; adiabat (slope −γP/V) steeper than isotherm (−P/V) ⇒ B adiabatic, C isothermal
